- File: scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh

The phrase "embed budget floor" reads like a floor/minimum that is being applied, which contradicts the actual behavior — the code intentionally does NOT clamp up to the floor when that would cause the assembled prompt to exceed the codex stdin cap.
  Why it fails at runtime: No runtime failure — the logic is correct and the warning is purely diagnostic. This is an operator-readability concern: the text could mislead someone troubleshooting sizing into thinking the floor was applied when it was not.
